# Dental Health

> Advanced dental treatments in Tirana, Albania. Trusted by patients from UK, Italy, Germany, Spain, and France. 4.9★ rated. Led by Dr. Shukri Jahiu, oral surgeon.

Dental Health is a premier dental clinic in Tirana, Albania, specializing in implantology, prosthetics, E.max restorations, and oral surgery. We serve international patients through our dental tourism program with full travel support.

Important notes:

- Consultations are available in English, Albanian, and Italian
- The clinic is located at Rruga Kosovare, Tirana, near the city lake
- Contact via WhatsApp: +355 68 665 8888 or email: info@dentalhealth.al
- Open Monday–Friday: 8 AM–8 PM, Saturday: 9 AM–2 PM

## Services

- [Cosmetic Dentistry](https://dentalhealth.al/our-services/cosmetic-dentistry/): Enhance your smile with modern cosmetic dentistry in Tirana, Albania. Teeth whitening, veneers, and smile makeovers.
- [Dental Implants](https://dentalhealth.al/our-services/dental-implants/): Restore your smile with safe, premium dental implants in Tirana, Albania. All-on-4 and All-on-6 implant solutions available.
- [Endodontics](https://dentalhealth.al/our-services/endodontics/): Expert root canal treatments and endodontic care in Tirana, Albania. Save your natural teeth with gentle, effective treatment.
- [Oral Surgery](https://dentalhealth.al/our-services/oral-surgery/): Trust our skilled team for safe, precise oral surgery procedures in Tirana, Albania. Wisdom tooth extraction and more.
- [Orthodontic Appliances](https://dentalhealth.al/our-services/orthodontic-appliances/): Straighten your teeth with modern orthodontic appliances in Tirana, Albania. Clear aligners, braces, and retainers.
- [Prosthetics](https://dentalhealth.al/our-services/prosthetics/): Quality dental prosthetics in Tirana, Albania. Custom crowns, bridges, and dentures to restore your smile.
